description: Inspect retained captured Sentry envelopes and available item types, sizes, spans and payload details. Coverage depends on supported hooks. Local capture does not prove successful delivery, ingestion or billing impact. Filter by item type to investigate the available evidence.

deviceId.description: The device to act on: its id from list_devices or from your instructions. Pass it whenever more than one app may be connected. Once a call names a device, later calls in this session use it when deviceId is left out.

type.description: Only envelopes containing this item type, e.g. 'event' for errors or 'transaction' for traces.

name: get_sentry_envelopes
